We are bumping to 24. ### Moving to Microsoft Container Registry We have a security requirement to use images from [mcr.microsoft.com](https://mcr.microsoft.com/). However, MCR does not mirror official Node.js image > 18. When bumping `selfsigned`, it seems it need a newer version of Node.js that support Web Crypto. If we are right, we need to bump to a newer Node.js. As MCR don't mirror official image > 18, we have to use images by MCR.
